baseline.description: Status quo — no CCS, no new gas, no early retirements. Economic retirements only (driven by market conditions in each sweep scenario).

ccs_top_emitters.description: CCS retrofit on the 4 largest ERCOT CCGTs (Deer Park, Colorado Bend II, Wolf Hollow II, Guadalupe) by 2030-2032. These 4 plants represent ~4.7 GW and ~10 Mt/yr baseline emissions.

new_fossil_overlap_notes: Both grid-level (47,990 MW) and fleet-level (1,200 MW) new fossil in PJM 2030. Combined 49,190 MW is additive per interaction rule.
Both grid-level (21,244 MW) and fleet-level (1,200 MW) new fossil in PJM 2035. Combined 22,444 MW is additive per interaction rule.
Both grid-level (34,317 MW) and fleet-level (1,200 MW) new fossil in PJM 2040. Combined 35,517 MW is additive per interaction rule.
Both grid-level (36,680 MW) and fleet-level (1,200 MW) new fossil in PJM 2045. Combined 37,880 MW is additive per interaction rule.
Both grid-level (38,800 MW) and fleet-level (1,200 MW) new fossil in PJM 2050. Combined 40,000 MW is additive per interaction rule.
ccs_plus_new_gas.description: CCS on top ERCOT emitters + 1,200 MW new efficient CCGT in PJM to replace aging peakers. New plant online 2028 with best-in-class heat rate (6.3 MMBtu/MWh). Fleet-level gas additions are additive to grid-level new fossil builds (see new_build_interaction rule).

retire_peakers_ccs_baseload.description: Retire all oil CTs and gas CTs by 2030, CCS retrofit on all remaining gas CCGTs by 2035. Aggressive decarbonization pathway — eliminates peaker fleet entirely and captures residual CCGT emissions.

sbti_15c.description: SBTi 1.5°C pathway: -4.2% annual linear reduction from 2023 baseline.

at_power_nz.description: Constellation committed target: 95% reduction by 2040, net-zero by 2045.
